seo.description: Frequently asked questions about Sahil Sian's paintings, prints and commissions.

layout.title: FAQ
layout.description: Answers to common questions about my paintings, prints and commissions.

items.question: Where will you be painting next?
items.answer: Follow my Instagram [@sahilcyan](https://www.instagram.com/sahilcyan/) for updates on locations. I will usually update my story on new paintings and when I'm painting.

items.question: Do you do commissions?
items.answer: Yes I do. I do not paint from photographs and will only do commissions from life. You can request one through my [commission form](/commissions).

items.question: How much do you charge?
items.answer: My commission rate is $3.00 per square inch. I may charge extra depending on materials, commute, painting size and more.

items.question: Do you sell originals?
items.answer: Yes I do, check out my [gallery](/products?collection=gallery).

items.question: Do you sell prints?
items.answer: Yes, prints are created on demand. You can inquire about purchasing a print via my [contact form](/contact).

items.question: How do I contact you?
items.answer: You may contact me via my [contact form](/contact).

items.question: How can I get notified for new prints or originals for sale?
items.answer: Please sign up to my mailing list below to get notified on print drops or originals for sale before anyone else.
